title: The Secret Agent
sourceTitle: The Secret Agent: A Simple Tale
author: Joseph Conrad
description: A failed anarchist plot exposes betrayal and vulnerable lives in London.

longDescription: This complete historical edition offers room to follow the author’s voice, setting and central concerns at their original pace. Character, social circumstance and the choices people make are part of its enduring appeal. The source edition retains its period language and introductory material; explore the credited source for publication and edition details.

authorInfo.bio: Joseph Conrad was a Polish-British novelist and story writer. He is regarded as one of the greatest writers in the English language and – though he did not speak English fluently until his twenties – he became a master prose stylist who brought a non-English sensibility into English literature.
